```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(modulatR)
```

```{r}
dose_levels <- c(
  "none",
  "low",
  "medium",
  "high",
  "very_high"
)

dose_score <- c(
  none = 0,
  low = 1,
  medium = 2,
  high = 3,
  very_high = 4
)
```

```{r}
# Treatment mechanism helpers ----

clip <- function(x, lower, upper) {
  pmin(
    pmax(x, lower),
    upper
  )
}


treatment_probabilities <- function(df, t) {
  severity_col <- paste0("severity", t)
  toxicity_col <- paste0("toxicity", t)

  severity <- df[[severity_col]]
  toxicity <- df[[toxicity_col]]

  previous_dose <- if (t == 1L) {
    rep(0, nrow(df))
  } else {
    unname(
      dose_score[
        df[[paste0("A", t - 1L)]]
      ]
    )
  }

  # The preferred treatment intensity rises with disease severity and tends to
  # remain near the previous treatment level, but falls as toxicity increases.
  preferred_dose <-
    1.10 +
    0.75 * severity -
    0.65 * toxicity +
    0.25 * df$baseline_risk +
    0.30 * df$frailty +
    0.35 * previous_dose

  preferred_dose <- clip(
    preferred_dose,
    lower = 0.10,
    upper = 3.90
  )

  score_values <- unname(
    dose_score[
      dose_levels
    ]
  )

  # Mild category-specific preferences keep the treatment distribution from
  # being perfectly symmetric.
  category_bias <- c(
    0.10,
    0.05,
    0.00,
    -0.05,
    -0.10
  )

  eta <- vapply(
    score_values,
    function(k) {
      -0.70 * (k - preferred_dose)^2
    },
    numeric(nrow(df))
  )

  eta <- sweep(
    eta,
    MARGIN = 2,
    STATS = category_bias,
    FUN = "+"
  )

  # Numerically stable row-wise softmax.
  eta <- eta - apply(
    eta,
    MARGIN = 1,
    FUN = max
  )

  exp_eta <- exp(eta)

  probs <- exp_eta / rowSums(exp_eta)

  colnames(probs) <- dose_levels

  probs
}


draw_treatment <- function(df,
                           t,
                           u = stats::runif(nrow(df))) {
  probs <- treatment_probabilities(
    df = df,
    t = t
  )

  cumulative_probs <- t(
    apply(
      probs,
      MARGIN = 1,
      FUN = cumsum
    )
  )

  category_index <- 1L +
    rowSums(
      u > cumulative_probs
    )

  dose_levels[
    category_index
  ]
}
```

```{r}
# Policy helper ----

modify_dose <- function(A,
                        severity,
                        toxicity) {
  score <- unname(
    dose_score[A]
  )

  # High toxicity takes priority over escalation.
  deescalate <-
    toxicity > 1.00 &
    score > 0

  escalate <-
    !deescalate &
    severity > 0.50 &
    toxicity < 0.75 &
    score < 4

  modified_score <-
    score -
    as.integer(deescalate) +
    as.integer(escalate)

  dose_levels[
    modified_score + 1L
  ]
}
```

```{r}
# Construct time-specific categorical MTPs ----

mtp_t1 <- mtp_discrete(
  map_fun = function(A, H_df) {
    modify_dose(
      A = A,
      severity = H_df$severity1,
      toxicity = H_df$toxicity1
    )
  },
  support = dose_levels,
  name = "adaptive_dose_t1"
)


mtp_t2 <- mtp_discrete(
  map_fun = function(A, H_df) {
    modify_dose(
      A = A,
      severity = H_df$severity2,
      toxicity = H_df$toxicity2
    )
  },
  support = dose_levels,
  name = "adaptive_dose_t2"
)


mtp_t3 <- mtp_discrete(
  map_fun = function(A, H_df) {
    modify_dose(
      A = A,
      severity = H_df$severity3,
      toxicity = H_df$toxicity3
    )
  },
  support = dose_levels,
  name = "adaptive_dose_t3"
)


policy_adaptive <- LMTPPolicySequence$new(
  policies = list(
    mtp_t1,
    mtp_t2,
    mtp_t3
  ),
  name = "adaptive_escalation_deescalation"
)
```

```{r}
# Generate exogenous variables ----

generate_exogenous_data <- function(n) {
  data.frame(
    baseline_risk = stats::rnorm(n),
    frailty = stats::rbinom(
      n,
      size = 1,
      prob = 0.35
    ),

    e_severity1 = stats::rnorm(n),
    e_toxicity1 = stats::rnorm(n),

    e_severity2 = stats::rnorm(n),
    e_toxicity2 = stats::rnorm(n),

    e_severity3 = stats::rnorm(n),
    e_toxicity3 = stats::rnorm(n),

    u_A1 = stats::runif(n),
    u_A2 = stats::runif(n),
    u_A3 = stats::runif(n),

    e_Y = stats::rnorm(n)
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Simulate one longitudinal trajectory regime ----

simulate_trajectory <- function(exogenous,
                                apply_policy = FALSE) {
  n <- nrow(exogenous)

  baseline_risk <- exogenous$baseline_risk
  frailty <- exogenous$frailty

  # Time 1 covariates
  severity1 <-
    0.70 * baseline_risk +
    0.45 * frailty +
    exogenous$e_severity1

  toxicity1 <-
    0.20 * frailty +
    0.50 * exogenous$e_toxicity1

  H1 <- data.frame(
    baseline_risk = baseline_risk,
    frailty = frailty,
    severity1 = severity1,
    toxicity1 = toxicity1
  )

  # Natural treatment draw under the current history.
  A1_natural <- draw_treatment(
    df = H1,
    t = 1,
    u = exogenous$u_A1
  )

  A1 <- if (apply_policy) {
    modify_dose(
      A = A1_natural,
      severity = severity1,
      toxicity = toxicity1
    )
  } else {
    A1_natural
  }

  dose1 <- unname(
    dose_score[A1]
  )

  # Time 2 covariates depend on the treatment actually delivered at time 1.
  severity2 <-
    0.55 * severity1 +
    0.30 * baseline_risk +
    0.20 * frailty -
    0.30 * dose1 +
    0.12 * severity1 * frailty +
    exogenous$e_severity2

  toxicity2 <-
    0.45 * toxicity1 +
    0.20 * frailty +
    0.28 * dose1 +
    0.06 * dose1^2 +
    0.60 * exogenous$e_toxicity2

  H2 <- data.frame(
    baseline_risk = baseline_risk,
    frailty = frailty,
    severity1 = severity1,
    toxicity1 = toxicity1,
    A1 = A1,
    severity2 = severity2,
    toxicity2 = toxicity2
  )

  A2_natural <- draw_treatment(
    df = H2,
    t = 2,
    u = exogenous$u_A2
  )

  A2 <- if (apply_policy) {
    modify_dose(
      A = A2_natural,
      severity = severity2,
      toxicity = toxicity2
    )
  } else {
    A2_natural
  }

  dose2 <- unname(
    dose_score[A2]
  )

  # Time 3 covariates depend on the modified/observed treatment at time 2.
  severity3 <-
    0.50 * severity2 +
    0.20 * baseline_risk +
    0.15 * frailty -
    0.32 * dose2 +
    0.08 * severity2^2 +
    exogenous$e_severity3

  toxicity3 <-
    0.50 * toxicity2 +
    0.15 * frailty +
    0.30 * dose2 +
    0.05 * dose2^2 +
    0.60 * exogenous$e_toxicity3

  H3 <- data.frame(
    baseline_risk = baseline_risk,
    frailty = frailty,
    severity1 = severity1,
    toxicity1 = toxicity1,
    A1 = A1,
    severity2 = severity2,
    toxicity2 = toxicity2,
    A2 = A2,
    severity3 = severity3,
    toxicity3 = toxicity3
  )

  A3_natural <- draw_treatment(
    df = H3,
    t = 3,
    u = exogenous$u_A3
  )

  A3 <- if (apply_policy) {
    modify_dose(
      A = A3_natural,
      severity = severity3,
      toxicity = toxicity3
    )
  } else {
    A3_natural
  }

  dose3 <- unname(
    dose_score[A3]
  )

  # Higher values are better.
  #
  # Treatment has both indirect benefit through severity reduction and direct
  # toxicity/cost tradeoffs.
  Y <-
    10 +
    0.30 * baseline_risk -
    0.20 * frailty -
    0.35 * severity2 -
    1.00 * severity3 -
    0.25 * toxicity2 -
    0.75 * toxicity3 +
    0.20 * dose3 -
    0.04 * dose3^2 +
    exogenous$e_Y

  data.frame(
    baseline_risk = baseline_risk,
    frailty = frailty,

    severity1 = severity1,
    toxicity1 = toxicity1,
    A1 = A1,

    severity2 = severity2,
    toxicity2 = toxicity2,
    A2 = A2,

    severity3 = severity3,
    toxicity3 = toxicity3,
    A3 = A3,

    Y = Y,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Monte Carlo truth ----

set.seed(1001)

n_truth <- 250000

exo_truth <- generate_exogenous_data(
  n = n_truth
)

truth_natural_data <- simulate_trajectory(
  exogenous = exo_truth,
  apply_policy = FALSE
)

truth_policy_data <- simulate_trajectory(
  exogenous = exo_truth,
  apply_policy = TRUE
)

truth <- c(
  EY = mean(
    truth_natural_data$Y
  ),
  EYd = mean(
    truth_policy_data$Y
  ),
  difference = mean(
    truth_policy_data$Y -
      truth_natural_data$Y
  )
)

truth_mc_se <- c(
  EY = stats::sd(
    truth_natural_data$Y
  ) / sqrt(n_truth),

  EYd = stats::sd(
    truth_policy_data$Y
  ) / sqrt(n_truth),

  difference = stats::sd(
    truth_policy_data$Y -
      truth_natural_data$Y
  ) / sqrt(n_truth)
)

rbind(
  truth = truth,
  Monte_Carlo_SE = truth_mc_se
)
```

```{r}
# Observed estimation sample ----

set.seed(2002)

n <- 15000

observed_data <- simulate_trajectory(
  exogenous = generate_exogenous_data(n),
  apply_policy = FALSE
)

ds <- LMTPData$new(
  data = observed_data,

  W_cols = c(
    "baseline_risk",
    "frailty"
  ),

  L_cols = list(
    c(
      "severity1",
      "toxicity1"
    ),
    c(
      "severity2",
      "toxicity2"
    ),
    c(
      "severity3",
      "toxicity3"
    )
  ),

  A_cols = c(
    "A1",
    "A2",
    "A3"
  ),

  Y_col = "Y"
)

ds
```

```{r}
# Inspect policy modifications ----

A1_d <- policy_adaptive$apply_t(
  t = 1,
  A_vec = ds$A(1),
  H_df = ds$H(1)
)

A2_d <- policy_adaptive$apply_t(
  t = 2,
  A_vec = ds$A(2),
  H_df = ds$H(2)
)

A3_d <- policy_adaptive$apply_t(
  t = 3,
  A_vec = ds$A(3),
  H_df = ds$H(3)
)


table(
  observed = ds$A(1),
  modified = A1_d
)

table(
  observed = ds$A(2),
  modified = A2_d
)

table(
  observed = ds$A(3),
  modified = A3_d
)
```

```{r}
data.frame(
  time = 1:3,

  proportion_changed = c(
    mean(ds$A(1) != A1_d),
    mean(ds$A(2) != A2_d),
    mean(ds$A(3) != A3_d)
  )
)
```

```{r}
# Oracle categorical g learners ----

make_oracle_g_learner <- function(t) {
  force(t)

  function(data) {
    function(newdata) {
      probs <- treatment_probabilities(
        df = newdata$df,
        t = t
      )

      A_col <- paste0(
        "A",
        t
      )

      treatment_index <- match(
        newdata$df[[A_col]],
        dose_levels
      )

      if (anyNA(treatment_index)) {
        stop(
          "Encountered a treatment value outside `dose_levels`."
        )
      }

      probs[
        cbind(
          seq_len(newdata$n),
          treatment_index
        )
      ]
    }
  }
}


g_learners <- lapply(
  1:3,
  make_oracle_g_learner
)
```

```{r}
# Sequential outcome-regression learners ----

m_formula_t1 <-
  `..pseudo_outcome` ~
  baseline_risk +
  I(baseline_risk^2) +
  frailty +
  severity1 +
  I(severity1^2) +
  toxicity1 +
  I(toxicity1^2) +
  A1 +
  severity1:toxicity1


m_formula_t2 <-
  `..pseudo_outcome` ~
  baseline_risk +
  I(baseline_risk^2) +
  frailty +
  severity1 +
  toxicity1 +
  A1 +
  severity2 +
  I(severity2^2) +
  toxicity2 +
  I(toxicity2^2) +
  A2 +
  severity2:toxicity2


m_formula_t3 <-
  `..pseudo_outcome` ~
  baseline_risk +
  I(baseline_risk^2) +
  frailty +
  severity1 +
  toxicity1 +
  A1 +
  severity2 +
  toxicity2 +
  A2 +
  severity3 +
  I(severity3^2) +
  toxicity3 +
  I(toxicity3^2) +
  A3 +
  severity3:toxicity3


m_learners <- make_glm_m_learners(
  tau = ds$tau(),
  family = stats::gaussian(),
  formula = list(
    m_formula_t1,
    m_formula_t2,
    m_formula_t3
  )
)
```

```{r}
# Fit adaptive categorical LMTP TMLE ----

nuisance_factory <- LMTPNuisanceFactory$new(
  policy_seq = policy_adaptive,
  m_learners = m_learners,
  g_learners = g_learners,
  truncate_density = 1e-12,
  truncate_ratio = c(
    1e-6,
    1e6
  )
)


fluctuation <- LMTPFluctuationSubmodel$new(
  family = stats::gaussian()
)


fit <- run_tmle_for_LMTP(
  ds = ds,
  nuisance_factory = nuisance_factory,
  fluctuation = fluctuation
)

fit
```

```{r}
# Compare estimate with Monte Carlo truth ----

comparison <- data.frame(
  estimand = "E[Y^d]",
  truth = unname(
    truth["EYd"]
  ),
  truth_mc_se = unname(
    truth_mc_se["EYd"]
  ),
  estimate = unname(
    fit$estimate
  ),
  se = unname(
    fit$se
  ),
  lower = unname(
    fit$ci["lower"]
  ),
  upper = unname(
    fit$ci["upper"]
  )
)

comparison$error <-
  comparison$estimate -
  comparison$truth

comparison$z_from_truth <-
  comparison$error /
  sqrt(
    comparison$se^2 +
      comparison$truth_mc_se^2
  )

comparison
```

```{r}
# End-to-end sanity check ----

combined_se <- sqrt(
  fit$se^2 +
    truth_mc_se["EYd"]^2
)

stopifnot(
  abs(
    fit$estimate -
      truth["EYd"]
  ) <
    4 * combined_se
)
```

# Density-ratio diagnostics ----

ratio_diagnostics <- data.frame(
  time = 1:ds$tau(),

  mean_r = vapply(
    nuisance_factory$r_obs_preds,
    mean,
    numeric(1)
  ),

  min_r = vapply(
    nuisance_factory$r_obs_preds,
    min,
    numeric(1)
  ),

  max_r = vapply(
    nuisance_factory$r_obs_preds,
    max,
    numeric(1)
  ),

  mean_omega = vapply(
    nuisance_factory$omega_preds,
    mean,
    numeric(1)
  ),

  min_omega = vapply(
    nuisance_factory$omega_preds,
    min,
    numeric(1)
  ),

  max_omega = vapply(
    nuisance_factory$omega_preds,

)

ratio_diagnostics
